problem: Production contained a mobile language selector, but the verifier preferred a hidden shared-nav selector whenever it merely existed in the DOM.
root_cause: DOM existence was used as a proxy for user-visible actionability.
prevention: Production interaction proofs must select :visible controls, not the first DOM match.
Hidden duplicate navigation hosts may exist and must never outrank visible controls.
Failure diagnostics must record counts and visibility state for all candidate hosts.

evidence.failure: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation
